title: Aspen Search odometer figure
description: A big figure whose digits spin up like an odometer as it scrolls into view, each reel a little behind the one before; symbols like $, + and – stay still.
notes: CSS only (view timeline, scrubbed with the scroll); static HTML shows the final figure
set the font size on it or its parent; line height is 1
name: aspensearch-odometer

props.name: value
props.description: the figure to show, e.g. "500+" or "$1M–5M"; each digit rolls, other characters stay put
